svg.title: Order changes the question
svg.desc: Generic method-design figure, not a named architectural study or tested stimulus set. Four schematic rooms share all geometry except opening width. Fixed orders are contrasted with a balanced four-order arrangement. Each condition occurs once at each position, and each directed adjacent-condition pair appears once across the balanced orders. Repeated reference anchors inspect drift but do not remove all order or carryover effects. Response periods remain separate from exposure. No participant outcomes are depicted.
